Question: I want to know the meaning of Zainab.Is this name is suitable for my daughter? My name is Rizwan Shahzad & my wife name is Asma Bashir. Please also suggest me a good islamic name for my daughter, she was born on 7th july 2008.please help in this regard. Answer ID: 6460 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1109/1037=D/1429) Zainab is the name of the Prophet?s elder daughter; it is enough for the name to be nice. It is good if you have kept the name, if you did not choose it yet, choose any from the below names: حفصہ، زینب، ام کلثوم، رقیہ، مریم، عائشہ، ایمن Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
